::: {#exr-bonferroni-fwer}
#### Probability of a false positive under the Bonferroni correction

Let $m$ null hypotheses have valid p-values (@def-valid-p-value),
let $\truenulls$ be the set of $m_0$ indices of the true null hypotheses,
and let $V$ be the number of true null hypotheses that the
[Bonferroni correction](#def-bonferroni) at level $\siglevel$ rejects.
Show that $\Prf{V \ge 1} \le m_0 \siglevel / m$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#sol-bonferroni-fwer}

The steps use the Bonferroni rule (@def-bonferroni),
the union bound (@thm-union-bound)
and the validity of each p-value (@def-valid-p-value).

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Prf{V \ge 1}
&= \Prf{\bigcup_{j \in \truenulls} \set{H_j \text{ is rejected}}}
&& \text{($V \ge 1$ means some true null hypothesis is rejected)}\\
&= \Prf{\bigcup_{j \in \truenulls} \set{p_j \le \siglevel / m}}
&& \text{(the Bonferroni rule)}\\
&\le \sum_{j \in \truenulls} \Prf{p_j \le \siglevel / m}
&& \text{(union bound)}\\
&\le \sum_{j \in \truenulls} \frac{\siglevel}{m}
&& \text{(each $p_j$ is valid, with $u = \siglevel / m$)}\\
&= m_0 \cdot \frac{\siglevel}{m}
&& \text{(a sum of $m_0$ equal terms)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
